jobs.title: Project / Program Manager
jobs.jd_full:
The Project / Program Manager keeps the implementation on track and manages the organisational change that agentic AI inevitably introduces. This role coordinates across technical, operations, and business stakeholders, owns the delivery timeline, and ensures that the people, process, and governance dimensions of the deployment receive the same rigour as the technology.

Accountabilities

  • Delivery Ownership: Accountable for the end-to-end delivery of implementation projects on time, within scope, and within budget.
  • Stakeholder & Change Management: Accountable for managing the organisational and stakeholder change that agentic AI deployments introduce across client, partner, and internal teams.
  • Risk & Governance: Accountable for project risk management and for establishing, contributing to, and executing PMO processes and governance standards.
  • Resource & Scope Management: Ownership of resource allocation, and of any changes to project scope, schedule, or cost.
  • Team Enablement: Accountable for mentoring and providing functional delivery leadership — direction, prioritisation, and day-to-day coordination on project tasks — to the cross-functional implementation team (Tech Lead, Developers, QA, Integrations Engineer), without formal (hierarchical) management authority over these roles. Performance management, career development, and formal reporting lines for these team members remain with their respective functional managers.

Key Responsibilities

    • Assist in defining project scope and objectives with all relevant stakeholders, ensuring overall project feasibility.
    • Develop and maintain a detailed project plan to monitor and track progress against milestones.
    • Manage relationships with the client, partners, third-party vendors, and project stakeholders.
    • Perform risk management activities to identify and minimise project risks.
    • Maintain project documentation (plans, status reports, RAID logs).
    • Contribute to and monitor product enhancement requests arising from project requirements.
    • Establish, contribute to, and execute PMO processes across the implementation practice.
    • Provide day-to-day delivery leadership and mentoring to the project team on a functional basis, coordinating priorities and task execution without formal line-management authority.
    • Understand the technical tasks behind each deliverable well enough to plan, sequence, and challenge estimates. Track technical progress at task level not just milestone level, and identify slippage early.
    • Support the requirements and design process, contributing to the gathering, clarification, and validation of technical and functional requirements with client and internal teams, and to their translation into implementable specifications.

Requirements

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Management, Engineering, or equivalent work experience.
  • Solid organisational skills, including attention to detail and multitasking ability.
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills — English, Portuguese, and Spanish.
  • Excellent client-facing and internal stakeholder communication skills.
  • Experience creating detailed reports and delivering presentations.
  • Resilient, positive attitude and comfort operating under pressure and challenge.

Nice to have:

  • PMP, PRINCE2, or Agile/Scrum certification.
  • Experience managing conversational AI, IVR, or CCaaS implementation projects.
  • Experience delivering projects for enterprise clients in banking, insurance, or utilities.
  • Familiarity with PMO tooling (e.g., Jira, MS Project, Smartsheet).

Benefits

  • Fixed compensation;
  • Long-term employment with the working days vacation;
  • Development in professional growth (courses, training, etc);
  • Being part of successful cutting-edge technology products that are making a global impact in the service industry;
  • Proficient and fun-to-work-with colleagues;
  • Apple gear

Omilia is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that embracing diversity in all its forms enriches our workplace and drives our collective success. We are committed to creating an environment where everyone feels welcomed, valued, and empowered to contribute their unique perspectives without regard to factors such as race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, heredity, disability, age, or veteran status, all eligible candidates will be given consideration for employment.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Servicing
jobs.jd_full:
ABOUT OUR COMPANY:

The crushing weight of debt is something that we believe holds people back from reaching their dreams and making a splash in the world. So in 2013, after seeing our friends and family struggle with student loans, we created Splash Financial.

Over the years, our mission has expanded to include helping people with other forms of debt - such as refinancing credit cards, which are at all time highs in the US. And we’ve been able to refinance $6+ Billion in loans through our network of Splash, powered credit union and bank partners who leverage our marketplace and automated loan processing technology. And we’ve raised over $135 million from investors like partners of DST Global, Citi Ventures, TruStage Ventures, Northwestern Mutual Future Ventures, Detroit Venture Partners, and more.

But at our core, we’re still that little company from Cleveland with a big dream: to make people more powerful than their debt and we’re just getting started..

ABOUT OUR WORKPLACE:

Splash is remote-first, and proud of it — though our collections team works in-person at our Arizona location.

We spend our days simplifying financial products and getting them into the hands of people who need them most. Right now, we’re focused on building financial technologies that fundamentally transform how the industry lends.

Although Splash has been around since 2013, we still operate like a startup — fast-paced, nimble, and full of heart. We’re good people who care deeply about doing meaningful work and we approach challenges with creativity, passion, and urgency.

And to hire the best, we provide the best: great health insurance, competitive salaries, and unique benefits like quarterly meet-ups and access to engagement tools that keep us connected — even from afar.

At Splash, everything we do is guided by our values:

Own It – We take full accountability and follow through on commitments.

Raise the Bar – We move fast, innovate faster, and push through barriers.

Say the Hard Thing – We speak up with honesty, respect, and a desire to solve problems and make things better.

Elevate Each Other – We win as a team by lifting each other up.

These values show up in how we work and how we connect — whether we’re collaborating on big projects or bonding over everyday moments. Yes, we even have Slack channels for #kids-and-pets and #food because we believe being human makes us better teammates.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

Splash Financial is seeking a Product Manager to own the borrower servicing experience. You’ll report to the Senior PM for Servicing, focused on building great customer experiences that directly impact how thousands of borrowers manage, repay, and interact with their loans. You’ll also play a key role in improving the operational processes and partner onboarding that sit behind those experiences.

This isn’t a support role. You’ll own your domains end to end: running discovery, writing requirements, partnering with engineering, design, and business stakeholders, and using data to make better decisions faster.

WHAT YOU’LL DO AT SPLASH:

  • Own the discovery and delivery of borrower-facing servicing features, with a focus on intuitive experiences that make it easy for borrowers to manage, repay, and stay on track with their loans.
  • Partner with lender implementation teams to translate partner servicing requirements into product requirements and support go-live delivery across credit union and bank partners.
  • Help maintain and evolve our servicing platform configuration, including loan settings, borrower communications, and platform-level changes.
  • Drive initiatives that reduce delinquency and improve payment behavior, including self-service improvements, payment plan optimization, and enrollment experiences.
  • Use AI tools to accelerate your own workflow, including drafting documents, synthesizing research, analyzing data, and automating repetitive tasks.
  • Develop working knowledge of loan sales, collections, and disbursements workflows, with growing ownership over time.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO SPLASH:

  • 2-5 years of product management experience in a fast-paced environment where you had real ownership and accountability for outcomes.
  • Demonstrated product craft: you can identify and frame problems clearly, translate them into executable requirements, and drive delivery within an agile PDLC.
  • A good eye for UX: you can articulate what makes an experience intuitive or broken and partner effectively with design.
  • Comfort using data to inform decisions and measure outcomes: you know how to ask the right questions, where to find the answers, and how to act on what you learn.
  • Clear, structured communication: you can translate between technical and non-technical audiences and keep stakeholders informed proactively.
  • Experience working with third-party platforms or vendors to ship product changes.
  • Proficiency with AI-powered productivity tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, Cursor) to accelerate research, analysis, and documentation.

NICE TO HAVE:

  • Experience in fintech, consumer lending, or a regulated environment.
  • Familiarity with loan servicing, payments, collections, or capital markets.
  • Experience working with bank, credit union, or platform partners to deliver product changes.
  • Experience running A/B tests or product experiments to improve conversion, engagement, or user behavior.
  • Familiarity with data and BI tools and product analytics tools; SQL proficiency is a plus.

COMPENSATION:

The base salary range for this role is $100,000 to $150,000 annually, based on market data and internal compensation practices. This role may also be eligible for a bonus component tied to individual and company performance. Final compensation will be determined by factors such as location, experience, and skill level.

SPLASHERS ENJOY:

  • Fully remote work freedom (for most roles)
  • Competitive salary packages
  • Flexible PTO + 9 company holidays
  • Equity: Share in our start-up success
  • Comprehensive and affordable insurance benefits
  • Paid parental leave for both caregivers
  • Essential modern equipment to get the job done
  • Fully paid Claude subscription to supercharge your work
  • 401(k) for your future savings
  • Quarterly meet-ups: In person & virtual fun
  • Awesome Splash swag to flaunt your team spirit

Employment at Splash is based on individual merit. Opportunities are open to all, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, creed, age, handicap, national origin, ancestry, military status, veteran status, medical condition, marital status, sexual orientation, affectional preference, or other irrelevant factors. Splash is an equal opportunity employer.

JOB OFFER & RECRUITMENT SCAM NOTICE

At Splash Financial, we want candidates to feel confident and safe throughout the hiring process. Unfortunately, scammers sometimes pose as employers to trick job seekers into sharing personal information or money.

PLEASE BE AWARE:

  • Splash Financial will never ask for payment, banking details, or cryptocurrency as part of our hiring process.
  • All legitimate job communications from Splash Financial will come from an @splashfinancial.com email address.
  • We do not conduct interviews solely via text message or chat apps.
  • Any offer of employment will be made only after a formal interview process and will be sent directly from Splash Financial.

IF YOU RECEIVE A SUSPICIOUS MESSAGE:

  • Do not respond or share personal information.
  • Do not click on unknown links or download attachments.
  • Report the message to careers@splashfinancial.com

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.jd_full:
The Senior Product Manager is responsible for leading product strategy, vision, and roadmap for GHX’s core clinical solutions, which help health systems benchmark clinical and procedural spend, optimize product utilization, and support value analysis and physician preference item (PPI) decision-making. This individual will ensure products deliver measurable clinical and financial value to hospitals and health systems. This role requires strong domain expertise in healthcare, clinical analytics, and procedural/surgical supply chain data, along with proven ability to independently break down complex, ambiguous problems into clear milestones and drive them to completion. This role will be reporting to the Director, Product Management and will regularly engage with cross-functional leaders across engineering, clinical strategy, sales, and customer success.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the technical and clinical domain expert on our clinical suite of solutions while working directly with a variety of stakeholders, both to assist in closing deals and to ensure positive customer experience
  • Independently break down large, ambiguous problems in the clinical analytics and physician preference item space into milestones and key initiatives, and hold cross-functional stakeholders accountable to target dates
  • Work closely with internal operations to establish high quality implementation norms with a focus on accelerating time to value for customers
  • Lead sales, product owners, and engineering team members to develop top-quality products by serving as a leader between customers/sales and engineering, even when problems are technically or clinically complex
  • Conduct research, including engagement with clinicians, value analysis committees, and supply chain leaders, to identify customer needs and market gaps in category optimization and physician-level analytics
  • Analyze the competitive landscape and market trends in healthcare clinical analytics and procurement optimization, then define and execute on strategies to be the market leader
  • Define, drive, and communicate product roadmaps aligned with corporate strategy, cross-portfolio product pod delivery, and new and existing capabilities
  • Partner closely with Product Pods and engineering delivery teams to prioritize work based on market demands and maximizing benefit to the business
  • Lead the development of value propositions and sales tools to be used by the sales team
  • Work closely with marketing and brand on external messaging and naming for the product
  • Lead cross-functional rollout and go-to-market of products and new feature sets
  • Train all customer-facing employees on product details, clinical value proposition, and sales techniques
  • Work with sales and finance to accurately build business cases to forecast and monitor the success of products, and use these measures to drive product strategy
  • Set and regularly evaluate product pricing using best-in-class pricing strategies
  • Effectively negotiate for your product through any internal prioritization processes
  • Ensure legal and regulatory requirements, including healthcare data privacy and security standards, are met, and any risks are mitigated through collaboration with legal
  • Ability to travel 25-50%

KEY COMPETENCIES

  • Demonstrated expertise in healthcare, clinical analytics, and procedural/surgical supply chain data, with fluency in physician preference items, value analysis, and provider procurement processes
  • Proven ability to independently break down complex, ambiguous problems into milestones, tasks, and target dates, and to assign and hold stakeholders accountable, following up as needed
  • Superior stakeholder communication skills — proactively identifies and mitigates hurdles before they become issues, and effectively translates feedback bidirectionally between technical and clinical/business audiences
  • Sound decision-making judgment, with the ability to weigh risk versus reward and drive stakeholder groups to a decision even amid disagreement
  • Strong technical fluency — able to confidently discuss why a system or data model is architected the way it is and what it will take to evolve it
  • Proven roadmap ownership, using data to drive prioritization and planning of future product iterations
  • Superior cross-functional collaboration across customers, sales, marketing, operations, development, and suppliers
  • Ability to work independently with a high degree of organization and attention to detail
  • Ability to mentor and support the development of more junior product managers

Required Education, Certifications, and Experience

  • Bachelor’s or higher in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, Health Informatics, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 7 years related work experience, including 4+ years of product management experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in healthcare, clinical analytics, or hospital/health system procurement and supply chain required.
  • Demonstrated experience developing data or analytics products that solve complex, ambiguous problems.

The compensation for this role is: $149,000 - $191,500

The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high end of the GHX’s salary range for this position. Actual salaries will vary based on various factors, such as the candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and proficiency for the role. The base salary is one component of GHX’s total compensation package for employees. Other rewards and benefits include: health, vision, and dental insurance, accident and life insurance, 401k matching, paid-time off, and education reimbursement, to name a few. To view more details of our benefits, visit us  here: https://www.ghx.com/about/careers/

jobs.title: Project Manager, People Initiatives
jobs.jd_full:
As Project Manager on our People & Culture (P&C) team, you’ll bring structure, accountability and a human touch to the projects shaping Booksy’s global team experience. Reporting to the Chief People Officer, you’ll help our P&C Leadership team break down silos and apply our resources with intention across our centres of excellence.

You’ll own delivery of the P&C Roadmap: leading weekly reviews, facilitating status updates and gathering feedback to drive continuous improvement. Working across teams, you’ll manage planning and budget processes, report to stakeholders inside and beyond P&C, and keep our global initiatives on course. It’s less about managing tasks than keeping an eye on the bigger picture; helping the team thrive as we pursue efficiency gains and opportunities with AI.

This isn’t a typical Project Manager role. We want someone who holds their own, challenges our P&C leadership and acts as a sounding board, and keeps our RACI model honest. If something’s off track or blocked, you flag it, you don’t wait to be asked. You’re solution-oriented by default, generating ways to unblock rather than simply escalating.

It’s important that you see ambiguity and significant change as exciting; not just for the team, but for your own career, as we redefine People initiatives in the AI era.

Essentially, to ensure you succeed in this role, you’re going to need:

  • A proven track record of delivering complex people projects on time and within scope, within a similar tech scale-up environment..
  • A formal Project Management qualification, such as Prince 2.
  • Familiarity with project management and communication tools, specifically Asana, Miro and Slack, you’re also comfortable navigating AI tools like Gemini and Claude.
  • Experience managing budgets and a structured, detail-oriented approach to delivery.
  • The ability to context-switch quickly and juggle multiple timelines independently.
  • Superb written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across all levels of stakeholders..

A career at Booksy means you’re part of a global team focused on helping people around the world feel great about themselves, every day. From empowering entrepreneurs to build successful businesses, to supporting their customers to arrange ‘me time’ moments, we’re in the business of helping people thrive and feel fantastic.

Working in a rapidly evolving company comes with its own set of opportunities and challenges. If you prefer a stable environment with clear processes and structures then, we’ve got to be honest, you won’t always find that here. However, if you’re a driven self-starter with the motivation to grow your career in an environment that’s rapidly changing as we scale-up globally, then the chances are that you’ll love it at Booksy.

Our Booksy UK Benefits:

  • This is a fully remote position within the UK, we take pride in being a globally distributed team
  • A holiday allowance of 25 days + public holidays + your birthday day off
  • Vitality Private Medical Cover (including dental and optical) with self-funded top up options for dependents
  • Access to Worksmile wellbeing app
  • Enhanced salary sacrifice pension scheme. Employee contributes 5% and Booksy matches at 5 %
  • Life assurance (4 x your annual salary)
  • Lifestyle discounts available through Vitality Program

We work in a highly creative and diverse industry, so it goes without saying that we strive to create an inclusive environment for all. We welcome people from all backgrounds and are committed to fair consideration in our hiring process. If you have any accessibility needs or require reasonable adjustments during the interview process, please contact us at belonging@booksy.com so we can best support you.

How AI helps us find great people

Think of our AI tool as a really smart assistant for our recruitment team. Its job? To help us move faster, stay consistent, and make sure no great candidates are overlooked. Every application goes through the same AI review to help us spot skills that match the role - but don’t worry, AI never makes the decisions. Real people do. Our recruiters and hiring managers handle every final call. And we regularly review how the tool is used to keep things fair, ethical, and compliant with data protection laws. Curious about how it works? You can always ask how AI was used in your application - it won’t affect your chances in any way.

jobs.title: Project Manager - Hybrid Role

jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager
jobs.jd_full:
Sr. Product Manager

Contract | Austin, TX

Explore a World of Diverse Problem-Solving

This is a one-of-a-kind opportunity to grow within an ambitious, people-first company but there can be many unknowns.  For that reason, our ideal candidate is committed, communicative, adaptable, results-oriented, and self aware.

As a Senior Product Manager, you will be at the forefront of our Discoveries initiative, a key component of our pre-sales strategy. Working remotely, but never alone, you’ll be a key player in an innovation lab, collaborating with our internal teams in sales, engineering, design, and project management, and directly engaging with a diverse range of clients across multiple industries.

This role offers unparalleled exposure, allowing you to strengthen your skillset as you transform varied ideas into cutting-edge tech solutions.

To respect your time and interest, we’re outlined our interview experience for you:

  1. 10-minute one-way video interview via Spark Hire
  2. 45-minute call with Recruiting Lead
  3. 45-minute Zoom with Team Lead, Product Management
  4. One hour Zoom with CEO and COO

Challenges and Opportunities

Getting shit done, brilliantly isn’t just a cheeky tagline.  We say what we mean, so get prepared to jump on board and quickly add value!

Be the Client’s Champion:

  • Serve as the principal advocate for our clients from discovery to implementation, ensuring a smooth, transparent journey aligned with their goals.
  • Commit to making a tangible difference by doing the right thing, making sure our clients feel valued and their voices heard.
  • Go beyond delivery by ensuring that the results we produce truly meet the clients’ needs and expectations, reinforcing that our success is measured not just by shipping, but by the real-world impact we make for our clients.

Drive the Strategy and Development:

  • Identify and address key problems to solve, defining success criteria in line with business objectives, market demands, and project constraints.
  • Engage deeply in requirement gathering and cross-functional collaboration to develop complete solutions, effectively bridging client needs and our technological capabilities.
  • Interact directly with customers to align product roadmaps with genuine user needs and strategically plan releases, fostering ongoing partnerships for future projects.
  • Utilize a range of Discovery techniques to effectively identify, develop, and organize user stories, achieving a detailed understanding of the user journey and their essential tasks.
  • Direct product delivery, including agile ceremonies like sprint planning, to convert visions into actionable plans, ensuring successful execution.
  • Collaborate with engineering to evaluate the product’s feasibility and viability, focusing on technical architecture and scalability to guarantee the delivery of robust solutions.

Foster Collaboration and Ignite Innovation:

  • Drive creative thinking through customer and stakeholder interviews, challenging conventional ideas to generate innovative solutions.
  • Collaborate with design and engineering to develop and refine prototypes, ensuring solutions address risks and validate value and viability.
  • Lead ongoing usability and value testing, focusing on user experience and product-market fit, and employing a mix of qualitative and quantitative strategies.
  • Encourage team adaptability to remain at the forefront of industry trends and embrace new technologies, further strengthening our capacity for innovation.
  • Guide your team, partner with clients to make necessary trade-offs, and leverage your expertise to tackle our customers’ most complex technology challenges with straightforward, yet effective and viable solutions.

Elevate Others:

  • Champion product thinking, nurturing strong collaboration across the team, particularly between designers and engineers.

  • Emphasize the importance of continuous learning and staying at the top of the latest in technology trends, product discovery, and delivery methodologies.

  • Shape our future by contributing to the vision and strategy for Discoveries, influencing long-term initiatives and approaches.

Qualifications and Experience

Experience that’s required (and really important to have):

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience
  • At least five years of experience in technology-powered product roles
  • Experienced with product-market fit and go-to-market strategy.
  • Demonstrated success in launching B2B, B2C, and/or B2B2C products or services.
  • Adept in high-growth environments where it’s commonplace to adapt to changing scenarios, time tight frames, and uncertainty
  • Proven success leading and fostering constructive and collaborative relationships with engineers, designers, and stakeholders
  • Advanced understanding of modern product discovery and delivery techniques
  • Ability to contribute across multiple business functions – such as design to engineering and marketing
  • Strong problem-solving with the capacity to make informed, risk-assessed decisions
  • Detail-orientation, with an keen ability manage multiple projects simultaneously
  • Persistence to help the team meet goals successfully
  • Empathy and a willingness to help others across the company

Wildly impressive folks will also have experience with:

  • Evangelist-type roles e.g. public speaking, content writing, et al.
  • Software engineering and/or web development
  • Proven experience working in both startups and enterprise environments.

We get shit done, brilliantly.

Founded by two great friends, Andy and James, Inventive exists to improve lives with bad-ass tech.  That’s our mission and why we show up every day.  Our goal is to make technology and innovation accessible to all.

We’re a community of entrepreneurs, women, and veterans connected through our passion for getting shit done, tireless attention to detail, and commitment to creating our best work - every time.

Every day, we solve complex problems in creative ways. Whether it’s helping launch powerful user experiences, modernizing systems and brands, or bringing visions to life with your own expertise, one thing is for sure: you’ll never be bored!  The best part?

People are the most important part of our mission.

If you can’t tell already, we are a fast-moving, fun-loving, seriously smart group of people who really care about improving lives.  We hire the best of the best who want to grow, thrive, and contribute in a meaningful way.

  • We’re a privately owned company with a people-first team.
  • We hire top performers that love a challenge and leave the bureaucracy to big tech.
  • We have been in business since 2016.

What’s special about this opportunity?

  • 100% Remote: Plug in where you’re most productive!
  • Ownership: Be trusted to make an impact. Everyone owns their role, 100%.
  • Variety: Create websites, mobile apps, and more for companies around the world.
  • Growth: Each project is totally different.Grow and learn in real time.
  • Stability: We grow responsibly.

Contracting at Inventive:

This role is budgeted for a part-time (15+ hours ongoing contract).

  • Consistency: Ongoing projects + strong backlog = no bench time!
  • Zero Travel: Forget your commute! No planes, trains, or automobiles are required here.

Inventive is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Customer Advocacy & Programs
jobs.jd_full:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

You’ll join our Customer Advocacy and Programs team, a small, high-impact team inside Customer Success, that amplifies the voice of the customer and turns feedback into measurable change. We synthesize customer input across touchpoints to surface the highest‑value opportunities, then partner with Product, GTM, Support, and Operations to turn those opportunities into strategy, deliverables, and lasting improvements. Our mission is to ensure Stripe’s most strategic customers get maximum value from their Stripe investments.

What you’ll do

As a Program Manager on the Customer Advocacy and Programs team, you’ll lead high-priority, cross-functional initiatives that improve how Stripe listens to, advocates for, and serves its users. Your portfolio may span customer feedback, servicing programs, operating processes, internal capabilities, and other emerging priorities across Customer Success.

You’ll take broadly defined problems from discovery through execution: developing a clear understanding of user and business needs, defining the right approach, aligning stakeholders, building an actionable plan, and driving work through launch, adoption, and iteration. You’ll move fluidly between strategy and hands-on delivery, bringing structure to ambiguity without introducing unnecessary process.

This is a generalist role for someone who can quickly develop context in new areas, identify the most important problems to solve, and mobilize teams around practical solutions. You’ll partner with leaders and frontline teams across Customer Success, Sales, Product, Support, Operations, Data, and other functions. The specific programs you own may evolve as Stripe’s users and organizational priorities change.

Responsibilities

  • Lead strategic programs end to end: Own a portfolio of high-priority initiatives from problem definition and strategy through planning, execution, launch, and measurement.
  • Turn ambiguity into action: Diagnose complex or loosely defined problems, identify their underlying causes, and translate them into clear objectives, scope, decisions, and workplans.
  • Drive cross-functional execution: Align stakeholders around shared outcomes, clarify roles and decision rights, manage dependencies and risks, and maintain momentum across teams with different priorities.
  • Represent users and frontline teams: Gather and synthesize qualitative and quantitative insights to understand user needs, frontline friction, and opportunities to improve the customer experience.
  • Establish measures of success: Define meaningful program outcomes and leading indicators, build feedback loops, and use evidence to determine what to expand, improve, or stop.
  • Communicate with clarity: Produce concise recommendations, decision documents, and leadership updates that surface the most important insights, trade-offs, risks, and actions.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in program management, business operations, strategy and operations, consulting, or a related discipline.
  • A track record of leading complex, cross-functional programs from an ambiguous starting point through implementation, adoption, and measurable outcomes.
  • Strong structured problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose problems, synthesize varied inputs, evaluate trade-offs, and develop practical recommendations.
  • Demonstrated ability to move between strategy and detailed execution and a willingness to personally drive the work required to deliver results.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create clarity for audiences ranging from frontline teams to senior leaders.
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, including experience aligning teams with different incentives, perspectives, or priorities.
  • Sound judgment and prioritization skills, particularly when operating with incomplete information or changing business needs.
  • A user-oriented approach and the ability to incorporate customer and frontline perspectives into program design and decision making.
  • High adaptability and comfort developing expertise quickly across unfamiliar or evolving problem areas.
  • High degree of comfort with AI tools.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience working with go-to-market or other customer-facing organizations.
  • Experience leading organizational change and driving adoption of new programs, tools, or ways of working.
  • Experience using data and qualitative research to assess problems, prioritize opportunities, and measure program effectiveness.
  • Experience partnering with technical teams to deliver tools, automation, or workflow improvements.
  • Comfort using AI tools to accelerate research, analysis, communication, or program delivery.
  • Prior experience in a high-growth technology, financial services, or payments environment.

jobs.title: Knowledge Program Manager
jobs.jd_full:
We’re transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Why this role is on the menu

The Customer Experience (CX) organization at Instacart is focused on making every interaction effortless, empathetic, and effective for our customers, shoppers, and partners. Our Knowledge team, spanning Knowledge Strategy, Content Operations, and Learning & Development, designs the programs, processes, and content that enable CX teams to deliver consistently excellent support at scale.

We are looking for a Knowledge Program Manager who will support the planning, coordination, and execution of programs across our unified Knowledge function. In this role, you will work alongside Program Managers and cross-functional stakeholders like CX Leaders, Operations, Quality, and Vendors to keep programs moving, track deliverables, manage intake and prioritization workflows, and ensure cross-functional partners stay aligned. You will thrive in this role if you are highly organized, comfortable in a fast-moving environment, and energized by connecting the dots between multiple workstreams to drive progress on things that matter.

What you’ll cook up in your first year

  • Support the end-to-end execution of knowledge and learning programs (e.g., onboarding, upskilling, content launches, process rollouts) by managing timelines, tracking milestones, and coordinating across stakeholders.
  • Manage and maintain program operating rhythms — including Jira intake boards, sprint tracking, launch calendars, and stakeholder communications — to keep work visible and on track.
  • Serve as a point of contact for cross-functional partners submitting requests, triaging incoming work through the intake process and routing to the right function (Knowledge Strategy, Content Operations, or Learning & Development).
  • Partner with subject matter experts, instructional designers, and knowledge strategists to gather inputs, track dependencies, and flag risks before they become blockers.
  • Draft and distribute program communications, status updates, and launch readiness materials for internal stakeholders and CX leaders.
  • Use program data — sprint velocity, backlog health, completion rates, and stakeholder feedback — to surface trends, report on program health, and support continuous improvement.

The secret ingredients we’re looking for

Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications)

  • 2–4 years of experience in Program Management, Project Management, Learning & Development, Knowledge Management, or a related field, with demonstrated ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously.
  • Proven ability to coordinate cross-functional work across teams with different priorities, timelines, and ways of working.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills — you keep details tight, deadlines visible, and stakeholders informed without being asked.
  • Clear, professional written and verbal communication skills; comfortable drafting status updates, intake summaries, and launch communications.
  • Comfortable working with tools like Jira, Google Suite, or similar project tracking and collaboration platforms.
  • Ability to operate independently on defined work while flagging ambiguity and escalating decisions appropriately.
  • Experience working with AI tools, such as Claude, Gumloop, Gemini, etc.

Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Experience supporting programs in a customer experience, contact center, operations, or similar high-volume environment.
  • Familiarity with L&D or knowledge management processes — intake, content review cycles, training launches, or knowledge governance.
  • Experience working in or alongside instructional design, knowledge strategy, or content operations teams.
  • Comfort with data — pulling reports, building trackers, and translating numbers into a clear story for stakeholders.
  • Exposure to process improvement frameworks or continuous improvement thinking (e.g., identifying bottlenecks, tightening SLAs, improving handoff quality).

#LI-Remote

Instacart provides highly market-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here.

Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please read more about our benefits offerings here.

jobs.title: Program Manager (PMP Required)
jobs.jd_full:
Ardent is seeking a Program Manager w/ PMP to join our team.

***Salary Range from $120k to $145k + growth incentive***

This is a remote position with frequent travel expected to Tallahassee, FL - candidates from Florida and nearby states are preferred.

Position Description:

Ardent is seeking a Program Manager to lead and oversee program delivery for a cybersecurity assurance program for the state of Florida. This position serves as the primary interface among company leadership, OCIG, agency OIGs, and technical leads. The role integrates project governance, access coordination, risk management, reporting, quality controls, and contractual deliverable acceptance across a potentially broad multi-agency environment.

Responsibilities and Duties:

  • Serve as the single accountable point of contact for OCIG and coordinate project management functions with the OCIG Contract Manager or designee.
  • Plan and conduct kickoff activities; document scope, roles, decisions, action owners, dependencies, communication protocols, risks, and approved deadlines in draft and final minutes.
  • Own the Master Project Plan and maintain approved milestones, staffing, testing waves, access readiness, risks, dependencies, decisions, corrective actions, and acceptance status.
  • Coordinate system access only through OCIG and Agency OIG channels; maintain the System Access Log and track approvals, authorized personnel, training, background screening, access periods, and obstacles.
  • Enforce scope discipline. Ensure no procedure, tool deployment, technique, system access, or scope change occurs without written authorization and incorporation into approved plans or Rules of Engagement.
  • Provide daily updates during active testing, bi-weekly program reviews, monthly project-plan submissions, and immediate escalation of critical vulnerabilities or deconfliction events as approved.
  • Oversee timely submission of all ten deliverables in required editable and PDF formats; log government comments and manage correction through acceptance.
  • Certify understanding of ingested materials and ensure agency risks inform sequencing, resource allocation, and testing priorities.
  • Maintain independence, objectivity, confidentiality, public-records sensitivity, and separation of factual AUP results from advisory recommendations.
  • Lead closeout reporting, lessons learned, final project-plan completion, and executive briefings.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in cybersecurity, information systems, engineering, business, project management, or related field; master’s degree preferred.
  • Active Project Management Professional (PMP).
  • 10 years of progressively responsible technology or cybersecurity program delivery experience, including multi-stakeholder government programs.
  • Demonstrated management of deliverable-based contracts, integrated schedules, project risk, quality controls, access dependencies, and executive reporting.
  • Experience coordinating cybersecurity assessment, continuous monitoring, audit-support, compliance, or control-validation work.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to present evidence-based information to C-suite, Board, Inspector General, or senior government stakeholders.
  • Working knowledge of NIST CSF, NIST risk-management concepts, cybersecurity control testing, and professional assurance practices.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Active Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP).
  • Experience supporting an Office of Inspector General, internal audit organization, or independent verification and validation program.
  • Familiarity with IIA Global Internal Audit Standards, GAO Government Auditing Standards, Rule 60GG-2, F.A.C., and Florida public-records constraints.
  • Experience coordinating work across numerous agencies or distributed operating environments.
  • Change-control, Agile, ITIL, or Lean portfolio credentials.

Due to the nature of the work we support, all candidates in consideration for this role must be willing to undergo and maintain a government-issued background investigation process. We highly encourage all Veterans and those with disabilities to apply.

Ardent is an equal opportunity employer. We will not discriminate in employment, recruitment, advertisements for employment, compensation, termination, upgrading, promotions, and other conditions of employment against any employee or job applicant on the bases of race, color, gender, national origin, age, religion, creed, disability, veteran’s status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, or any other basis protected by state, local, or federal law.

jobs.title: CPS Account Program Manager
jobs.jd_full:
Joining Collibra’s CPS Account Program Manager team

The Account Program Manager (APM) serves as the strategic partner and relationship manager for Collibra Public Sector’s Federal customers. This role is integral to ensuring customer satisfaction, driving adoption, and delivering value from Collibra’s solutions while collaborating closely with our Services and other GTM teams to create a seamless and resilient customer journey. This role directly influences retention, advocacy, and long-term account success.

In this role, you will bridge the gap between customer mission needs and our software solutions, coordinating the technical team towards delivering successful implementation, adoption, and value. The APMs primary responsibility is to partner closely with sales, services, support, customer engineering, and product teams to proactively safeguard account health, revenue, and customer satisfaction, by proactively identifying and mitigating risk, preventing and managing escalations, and assessing customer health.

Account Program Managers at Collibra Public Sector are responsible for

Relationship building and management

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned federal accounts, building trusted relationships with key stakeholders, system integrators and partners.
  • Establish long-term relationships within assigned government customers while developing an understanding of the client’s strategic goals and overall impact on business results.
  • Understand customers’ business objectives, technical needs, and success criteria, aligning Collibra’s services to meet their goals.
  • Support renewals and expansion by demonstrating technical value and best practices.
  • Understand customer mission objectives and map them to product capabilities.

Advocacy and operational readiness

  • Provide guidance during onboarding, deployment, upgrades, and ongoing operations.
  • Coordinate technical discussions, architecture reviews, and solution design sessions.
  • Assist with documentation, technical presentations, and briefings for government stakeholders.
  • Coordinate product functionality and roadmap meetings between product customers and the customer.

Planning and project management

  • Coordinate Support, Services and Customer Engineering on customer projects and initiatives by providing project leadership and guidance based on customer overall objectives.
  • Align services delivery with customer’s business needs by ensuring successful project execution and implementations are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned to customer goals.
  • Drive customer alignment on goals, success criteria, and acceptance milestones.
  • Track project progress and provide regular status updates to customers and internal leadership.
  • Understand the customer’s high-level business challenges while functioning as an advisory resource for “Best Practices” in driving adoption of Collibra’s solutions.
  • Manage scope, risks, issues, and dependencies across multiple concurrent projects.
  • Deliver reports for customers as required based on business objectives.

Health assessment and risk prevention

  • Identify and track key customer risk indicators (usage, sentiment, support volume, executive engagement, compliance).
  • Lead the effort with Sales and the technical teams to identify customer risk, performance issues, and opportunities for optimization.
  • Help customers avoid and/or mitigate issues with proactive guidance based on extensive customer experience.
  • Advocate for customer needs internally, influencing product roadmap and prioritization.

Escalation prevention and management

  • Act as point of contact for managing escalations, coordinating cross-functional resolution with Support, Product, and Engineering.
  • Provide clear and constructive product feedback to Collibra’s Product Management teams based on customer use-cases and requirements.
  • Be a customer advocate to ensure that escalations are resolved in a timely fashion.

You have

  • 5+ years of experience in a technical customer-facing role (TAM, Solutions Engineer, Systems Engineer, or similar)
  • Experience supporting U.S. federal government customers (civilian, DoD, or IC)
  • Strong understanding of enterprise software, SaaS, or cloud-based solutions
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Experience working in regulated or high-security environments
  • Excellent communication, organization, and stakeholder management skills
  • Experience deploying enterprise solutions
  • Knowledge of government hierarchy and operations
  • Strong business insight and problem-solving skills with the ability to influence internal and external stakeholders at all levels
  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as FedRAMP, NIST 800-53
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), especially GovCloud or equivalent
  • Experience working with system integrators
  • Knowledge of government hierarchy and operations
  • A solid technical background in data management
  • Active or eligible U.S. Government security clearance
  • Because this role supports the U.S. government business, it is required that this candidate be a U.S. citizen who resides on U.S. soil

You are

  • Exceptional in communication, presentation and interpersonal skills including the ability to communicate effectively and build relationships within government entities
  • Fast learner with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to a variety of audiences
  • Excellent in communication, organization, and stakeholder management skills

Measures of success

  • Within the first 30 days

    • Understand your customers objectives and ongoing efforts
    • Identify account risks and project blockers
    • Attend account team meetings for assigned accounts

  • Within the first 60 days

    • Develop a Success Plan for each assigned customer based on their objectives and ongoing efforts
    • Develop a remediation plan for customers at risk collaborating with the sales and technical teams
    • Participate in account team meetings for assigned accounts
    • Identify key customer contacts at all levels

  • Within the first 90 days

    • Begin to execute the Success Plan for each assigned customer
    • Begin to execute the remediation plan for customers at risk collaborating with the sales and technical teams
    • Lead account team meetings for assigned accounts
    • Begin to develop a relationship with key customer contacts at all levels

Compensation for this role

The standard base salary range for this position is $104,000 - $130,000 per year. This position is not eligible for additional commission-based compensation. Salary offers are based on a combination of factors, including, but not limited to, experience, skills, and location.

In addition to base salary, we offer a competitive total rewards package, including bonus potential, equity for eligible roles, a Flex Fund monthly stipend, pension/401k plans, and more.

Benefits at Collibra

Collibra recognizes and values that everyone has different needs, interests, and life goals. We built our benefits program with flexibility in mind to support you and your loved ones through a diverse range of circumstances and life events. These flexible offerings sit on a foundation of competitive compensation, health coverage, and time off. Learn more about Collibra’s benefits.

We create inclusion and belonging through how we onboard, meet, connect, engage, and communicate. Learn more about diversity, equity, and inclusion at Collibra.

At Collibra, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We realize the key to creating a company with a world-class culture and employee experience comes from who we hire and creating a workplace that celebrates everyone.

With this, we proudly consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, sex, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, physical or mental disability, HIV status, registered domestic partner status, caregiver status, marital status, veteran or military status, citizenship status or any other legally protected category.
